messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@beamanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:23:12 -0800
Subject: Request: supplemental credits for MLBench overnight soak

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood runtime looked promising. We're about to run a 48-hour soak focused on p95 latency and KV cache behavior as part of our MLBench validation. Our current sandbox allocation will run out early in the soak and we'd like to request a one-off supplemental credit allocation to finish the run.

High-level ask:
- Duration: 48 hours starting 11/18 (overnight to align with our engineering window)
- Estimated usage: ~75k token-equivalent (mostly generation + embed cache hits), peak ~1.2k qps for short bursts
- Goals: verify p95 under realistic arrival patterns and validate auto-batching impact on throughput

Attached is our short test plan that lists traffic patterns and target metrics. If you can provision a provisional top-up (or a safety cushion) that would prevent us from aborting mid-run, that would be huge. We can sign an MSA addendum or PO if required.

Attachment: mlbench-test-plan.pdf (application/pdf)

Would appreciate confirmation by Friday so we can finalize schedules.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of ML Engineering
Beam Analytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@beamanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:15:04 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental credits for MLBench overnight soak

Elena —

Appreciate the detailed plan. Quick clarifying questions before I take this to Ops for provisioning:
- Can you confirm the steady-state qps and the expected 95th latency target (ms)?
- Do you need the headroom to cover token generation only, or are you also planning embedding-heavy cold-starts that will increase per-token compute?
- Is there a contractual constraint (PO/MSA) that we should attach to the top-up?

We can do a provisional sandbox credit uplift while Finance reviews the PO. My initial suggestion (based on the numbers you shared) is to provision a 75k token safety credit scoped to a 48-hour window, with an internal Ops ticket to track usage and auto-revert if unused. If you want a higher buffer, we can escalate for approval.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm qps/p95 and whether embeddings are in-scope
2) I’ll create an Ops ticket and provisional top-up (50–75k tokens) pending PO or DocuSign signature
3) If approved, Ben will confirm any promotional credits or discounts to offset the incremental usage

Looping in Ben and Jonas — Ben can you review the discretionary credit and Jonas please flag any operational constraints for a 48h scoped uplift?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks, Grace — quick answers inline:
- Steady-state qps: ~600 qps with 10–20% 10s bursts up to ~1.2k qps
- Target p95: sub-180ms for generation path, embeddings p95 target is higher (~320ms) but not critical for this run
- Workload: mostly generation; embeddings will be used for a small subset (warm cache expected)

We're comfortable with a 75k token buffer for the 48h window. We can sign a short addendum or a PO; whichever is faster for you to provision.

Grafana snapshot of our expected pattern: https://beam.grafana.com/d/abc/soak-pattern

If you can provision the provisional uplift ASAP we’ll pin the run to 11/18 00:00 PST. Appreciate the help — this is a key gating item for our internal pilot approval.

—Elena

Elena —

Good news: we've provisioned a provisional uplift of 75,000 token-equivalent credits scoped to a 48-hour window starting 2026-11-18T00:00:00-08:00.

Operational notes:

- Billing: This is provisioned as a temporary sandbox uplift. Finance will expect either a PO (reference RDW-2026-8742) or a signed addendum. We can accept a DocuSign link if you prefer — I’ve included a placeholder below.
- Fallback: If traffic exceeds the buffer, we have automatic fallback to the next compatible model variant to preserve latency SLOs; Jonas will confirm the fallback threshold in INF-8723.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/packet/ABC12345

Ben — can you note any promotional credit you want applied post-run if usage is high?

Elena, please confirm you received the uplift and I’ll keep the ticket open until you close the soak. Good luck with the run — ping me if you want us to tail logs with you.

Best,
